<b>Dreg Husks</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are corpses possessed by [[Silk]] dregs that lash out with the sharp pins caught inside their thread.<ref>Dreg Husk [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Remains of a Citadel bug possessed by Silk dregs. The husk will lash out wildly with the many sharp pins caught inside its thread."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Dreg Husks hover aimlessly while idle, starting to float slowly over to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] once they have spotted her. They try to keep horizontal distance from Hornet, usually staying just out of [[Needle]] range. They have two moves they use depending on the situation:
* <b>Pin Lash:</b> Pins poke out of the Dreg Husk's head for a moment before it moves forward slightly and wildly lashes with pins and Silk in front of itself, comboing Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}} if she is caught at any point during the attack.
* <b>Evade:</b> Quickly dashes horizontally away from Hornet. They only use this move if she gets close after they miss with Pin Lash.

Due to Dreg Husks' slow speed and predictable movements, their attacks can easily be jumped over and [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bounced]].<br>
Alternatively, repeatedly striking them upwards whilst beneath them is an easy tactic to defeat them, as they cannot defend themselves from below and continually fly downwards back into striking range.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* ...Stretched... thin...
* ...Why?... again...
* ...I am... fading...
* ...Remember... shell...
* ...The shell... I was...
* ...The pain... forget the pain...
}}

== Location ==
One Dreg Husk can be found in the [[Whiteward]] to the west of the lift after picking up the [[Choral Commandment]] there, and another appears where the [[Surgeon's Key]] is found, either after picking up the key or re-entering the room.

Three Dreg Husks appear during the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)/Unravelled|fight]] with [[the Unravelled]], and up to two spawn in each wave of the infinitely respawning enemies in the arena once the boss is defeated.

== Trivia ==

* Dreg Husks do not drop organs for the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> or <i>[[Runtfeast]]</i> [[wishes]], nor do they release blood particles when hit, aligning with Hornet's mention of "hollowed husks" she saw in the Whiteward.<ref>Hornet dialogue with the [[Caretaker]]: <i>"In the ward down below, I saw it clear, the hollowed husks, and the many torturous implements... machines to instill a bug with thread, that would see their life extended."</i></ref>
